people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Gozan
people.line: A region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives were deported.

people.name: Habor
people.line: A river in Assyria where Israelite captives were settled.

people.name: Halah
people.line: A place where Israelites were exiled by the Assyrians.

people.name: Hoshea
people.line: The last king of Israel (northern kingdom).

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Media

people.name: Samaria

translations.web: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
translations.bsb: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria, where he settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
translations.kjv: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried ➔ Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
translations.asv: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away unto Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
